newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - FTSE options active amid market turmoil.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - FTSE options active amid market turmoil.

text.p: Index options were the focus of interest in the options market on Wednesday as world market suffered their second big shakeout of the past week, dealers said.

"It's not easy to trade in individual stock options when the market has been moving as fast as it has been," said one. "It's more of an index and futures day. We have seen some determined call selling and some aggressive put protection buying."
Volume in the December 4,100 American-style calls reached 1,678 contracts by 1613 GMT, while in the December 3,900 puts, some 2,973 lots were traded.
The FTSE 100 index was down 54.6 points at 3,981.1.
In Glaxo Wellcome Plc dealers highlighted a "straddle" trade in the January 950 puts and calls. Volume in the 950p calls reaced 625 lots and in the 950p puts reached 630 lots.
In LucasVarity Plc, dealers pinpointed a bullish buyer of a call spread which assumed a rise in the stock to about 250p from its current level of 229-1/2p.
In the February 240p calls, some 600 lots were traded and a similar volume was recorded in the February 260p calls.
